definitions.explanation: A barrier constructed to hold back water and create a reservoir.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ダム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They build a dam in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ダム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The water in the dam is decreasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ダム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They generate electricity with a large dam.

notes:
From English "dam." Refers to a barrier built across a river to hold back water, creating a reservoir (⟦{貯水池|ちょすいち}→貯水池：18172_chosuichi⟧).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ダム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to construct a dam
- ダム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{放流|ほうりゅう}→放流：18495_houryuu⟧: water release from a dam
- ダム⟦{湖|こ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧: reservoir, dam lake
- ⟦{水力|すいりょく}→水力：06434_suiryoku⟧ダム: hydroelectric dam
- ⟦{多目的|たもくてき}→多目的：18132_tamokuteki⟧ダム: multipurpose dam

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dams serve multiple purposes: ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧ (water supply), ⟦{治水|ちすい}→治水：27318_chisui⟧ (flood control), and ⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧ (power generation). Famous dams include {黒部|くろべ}ダム in {富山県|とやまけん}. Dam tourism (ダム{巡|めぐ}り) has become a popular hobby, with collectible "dam cards" (⟦{放流|ほうりゅう}→放流：18495_houryuu⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧) available at many sites.
